issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves the dependent task simultaneously completed and blocked, in an unrecoverable state
actual: "QA Full Task" was completed with prereqs {Buy groceries, Schedule dentist appointment} done. Reopening prerequisite "Schedule dentist appointment" was allowed without any warning or prompt. Afterwards QA Full Task is still counted as completed (Completed 4, summary "5 active, 4 completed"), still listed only in the completed view with line-through styling and data-semtag-state="completed", yet simultaneously renders the blocked warning 'Prerequisite "Schedule dentist appointment" incomplete'. The system neither prevented the reopen nor returned the dependent to an incomplete state. It is also unrecoverable: the dependent's complete toggle and edit button are both disabled (disabled=true), so the user cannot reopen or edit it out of this invalid completed+blocked state.
